text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to interpret and understand visual information from the world, such as photos and videos. One of its core tasks is image recognition, where a system identifies what an image contains, like a cat or a tree. A more advanced skill is object detection, which not only names objects but also locates them within a frame, often drawing boxes around them. This technology has many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other vehicles, allowing it to make safe driving decisions. From security cameras to medical imaging, computer vision is changing how machines "see" and assist us.
